page.overview:
Who is Fairy?

Fairies are generally small creatures with healing powers, and they usually fly by means of delicate, insect-like wings. Their appearances vary from game to game: in some games, such as , they resemble small orbs of light with four wings, while in others they take the form of tiny, winged humanoid females.

The second role held by is that of a traveling companion. In several games, beginning with , Link has been accompanied on his travels by companions. Unlike normal Fairies, they have the ability to speak (which is more explicit with Navi). Although in many cases they are used to facilitate gameplay (allowing Z-Targeting, for example), they also provide advice on what to do next or how to defeat certain enemies. In other games, such as , companion also serve as the cursor for guiding Link.

In , every , with the exception of Link before Navi is assigned as his partner by the , is partnered with such a guardian . In , the had companions in and . gets separated from them, and travels with the young Hero of Time to get his Hylian form back and to stop the from crashing into Termina.

In only, possess a unique role in that they are used as the Links' extra lives. Whenever a Link falls in battle (resulting in all four Links falling due to their shared health), a appears to revive him, and the Links are forced to restart the Stage of the Level. Three are brought into a Level when the Links enter the . If the heroes fall after losing their last , the Level is failed and the Links are forced to exit. After clearing a Level, any remaining are tallied and turned into bonus , multiplied by 30 for each (E.g. three will reward 90 ). In single-player mode only while using the , Link can use a to skip Stages and advance to the next one. Doing this, however, will empty all of the Rupees that Link has collected thus far, decrease the number of bonus Link earns after clearing the Level, and will replace the contents of a chest with 20 for each used.
